mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses the risk-free discount rate, reducing equity valuation costs and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic weakness.
evidence_refs: fact:Current FEDFUNDS at 0.14% is below 0.25% threshold
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% for consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness that triggers policy stimulus, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE remains above 7.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signal real economy contraction, triggering policy responses that generate positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:HOUST at 954.0 (down from 960.0) and GDPC1 at 13647.6 (Q4 2012)
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and GDPC1 fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases over 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply contraction (INDPRO below 95 for two consecutive months) triggers inventory depletion and price pressures that result in negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO remains below 95 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL monthly increase exceeding 0.3% signals inflationary pressure that prompts delayed rate cuts, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL mo/mo change exceeds 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increases (UNRATE > 7.5%) and non-farm payrolls declines (PAYEMS < 135,000) signal labor market deterioration, triggering policy stimulus that generates positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases over 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: Three consecutive months of retail sales decline (RSAFS < 420,000) indicate consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS declines for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts decline exceeding 1.0% (mo/mo) signals real estate sector weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST mo/mo change exceeds -1.0%.
